relevantChanges: HIGH/DEPRECATION: Task/Agent tool `mode` parameter deprecated and now ignored; subagents inherit the parent session's permission mode (2.1.212)

relevantChanges: HIGH: TodoWrite/TaskCreate/TaskGet/TaskUpdate/TaskList are left out by default on Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, Fable 5/5.1, Mythos 5 and newer (2.1.233). Opt-ins, all session-wide: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1 before launch, naming any one of the tools in --allowedTools, or listing them in --tools. Background sessions and Claude Code on the web have them on every model; a subagent has them only when the parent session does. CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TASKS=0 swaps the four Task tools for the legacy TodoWrite. Consequence: a --allowedTools ... TodoWrite ... grant in a workflow is the opt-in, not dead weight — the first draft of this sweep called those grants inert and was corrected against the tools reference
